note: Rendered verdicts, pinned. The Boardy rule: the rendered state is part of the asserted state, so changing what a reader sees is a deliberate act that updates this file. Regenerate with bun run scripts/check-verdict-projection.ts --write-golden and read the diff.

not_run.headline: Not recomputed yet.
not_run.detail: Nothing has been checked, which is not the same as nothing being wrong.

not_run_with_checks.headline: Not recomputed yet.
not_run_with_checks.detail: Nothing has been checked, which is not the same as nothing being wrong.

nothing_to_check.headline: Nothing to check.
nothing_to_check.detail: No checks were produced for this action, so this is neither a pass nor a mismatch — there was no recompute to judge.

all_pass.headline: Recomputed from public data — verified. No trust required.
all_pass.detail: Every hash was re-derived in your browser and the anchor was read from chain.

one_fail.headline: Recompute failed — your edited input no longer matches what was committed on-chain.
one_fail.detail: That red is the point: the check is really re-deriving the hashes, not faking green.

one_unverifiable.headline: Couldn't fully verify — the chain was unreachable.
one_unverifiable.detail: Every other row recomputed in your browser; the on-chain anchor just couldn't be read right now. That's could not check, not did not match — the checker won't hand you a green it didn't earn.
